--- /dev/null

@@ -0,0 +1,54 @@
+import pytest
+
+import jmespath
+from jmespath import exceptions
+from jmespath.parser import Parser
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def empty_cache():
+    Parser.purge()
+    yield
+    Parser.purge()
+
+
+def fill_cache():
+    return [jmespath.compile('lru_field_%s' % i)
+            for i in range(Parser._MAX_SIZE)]
+
+
+def test_compile_hit_protects_entry_and_evicts_least_recent():
+    entries = fill_cache()
+    assert jmespath.compile('lru_field_0') is entries[0]
+    jmespath.compile('lru_new')
+    assert jmespath.compile('lru_field_0') is entries[0]
+    assert jmespath.compile('lru_field_1') is not entries[1]
+
+
+def test_search_hit_and_cross_parser_hits_update_same_recency():
+    entries = fill_cache()
+    assert jmespath.search('lru_field_0', {'lru_field_0': 7}) == 7
+    assert Parser().parse('lru_field_1') is entries[1]
+    jmespath.compile('lru_new')
+    assert Parser().parse('lru_field_0') is entries[0]
+    assert jmespath.compile('lru_field_1') is entries[1]
+    assert jmespath.compile('lru_field_2') is not entries[2]
+
+
+def test_repeated_hits_do_not_consume_capacity():
+    entries = fill_cache()
+    for _ in range(20):
+        assert jmespath.compile('lru_field_0') is entries[0]
+    for i in range(1, Parser._MAX_SIZE):
+        assert jmespath.compile('lru_field_%s' % i) is entries[i]
+
+
+def test_invalid_expression_does_not_evict_and_purge_remains_shared():
+    entries = fill_cache()
+    with pytest.raises(exceptions.ParseError):
+        jmespath.compile('invalid[')
+    assert jmespath.compile('lru_field_0') is entries[0]
+    Parser().purge()
+    fresh = jmespath.compile('lru_field_0')
+    assert fresh is not entries[0]
+    assert fresh.parsed == entries[0].parsed
